featured_reviews.review_text:
I experienced extremely bad treatment at Somaiya Ayurvihar Hospital, which is a trust hospital. Honestly, even government hospitals have much better behavior compared to this.
After collecting the case paper, we went to the ward for the check-up. The nurse asked us to fill out a form, but her behavior was extremely rude. She said, “Don’t fill the form here, go outside and fill it,” and also told us, “Don’t sit here, go outside.” The tone and attitude were completely disrespectful.
Then we were told that boys/male attendants are not allowed, and I was asked to wait outside during my wife’s consultation time. How can this be acceptable? If some tests or examinations are being done, it is understandable. But during consultation, at least one family member should be allowed to stay with the patient. Whatever discussion, advice, precautions, or issues are being explained by the doctor should be known to both the patient and the family member. It is not possible to explain everything properly to the patient alone.
After this, my wife met the doctor, who was also very arrogant and rude. When my wife showed her the reports, the doctor said, “These are old reports, bring new ones.” My wife politely asked the doctor to please check the date, as they were the latest reports. After checking, the doctor had no answer and went silent.
Is this really the level of professionalism expected from doctors at such a reputed hospital?
This entire experience was extremely disappointing. A hospital of this level should focus on basic respect, patient dignity, and proper communication. The staff and doctors seriously need training in behavior and patient handling.
